intro: Every themed page fills the same five slots. A card's web slot map says how this theme fills each one.

slots.name: Hero signature
slots.role: The opening moment that only this subject could have. The theme dresses it; the subject still decides it.

slots.name: Section transitions
slots.role: How one chapter hands off to the next: wipes, rolls, cuts, decodes.

slots.name: Ambient layer
slots.role: The texture that runs under everything: grain, scanlines, haze, drifting particles. Always quiet, always pausable.

slots.name: Data skin
slots.role: How charts, numbers and labels look and move. Every data beat in the reel demonstrates one.

slots.name: Interaction and focus
slots.role: Hover, focus and press states, including the page's one call to action.

tiers.name: CSS and SVG
tiers.role: Transforms, gradients, clip paths and SVG strokes. The default tier and the safest.

tiers.name: Canvas and script
tiers.role: 2D canvas, particles and animation libraries. Needs a pause control when it runs past five seconds.

tiers.name: WebGL
tiers.role: Shaders and 3D. At most one WebGL layer per page, and never fluid simulation in B2B work.
